title: Rank-DML Scenario C
paper_sections: Section 4, Theorem thm:truncated and Proposition prop:lsfail
Appendix, Wilcoxon drift expansion and rare alignment errors
seed_derivation: SHA256 JSON [namespace, master, stage, case, n, rep, stream] to uint32 SeedSequence; 0-based replication

C1.innovations: Independent standard normals independent of X

C2.rare: X1 exceeds t(3) upper-tail quantile of probability n^(-3/4), scaled by sqrt(3)
C2.innovations: Independent standard normals independent of X
C2.learner: Scenario A Spline Ridge. Squared loss. 5 equally spaced clamped cubic knots per covariate incl training endpoints. 10 raw interactions among first 5 covariates. Training standardization and GCV over [0.1,1,10,100] separately for D/Y. Linear boundary extrapolation.
C2.diagnostic_grid: Independent stage/n-seeded scrambled Sobol. 1024 points conditional inside and 1024 outside; known region probabilities for full risks.

methods.Rank-W: Exact paper Q_n; monotone right subgradient computed by sorting; bracket tolerance 1e-12; five-point slope c=2; V=mean(w²)/(12 Gamma²)
methods.Huber: Scenario A IRLS sandwich, fold-specific threshold 1.345 × scaled MAD from training-only inner three-fold W residuals; deterministic residuals in C1
methods.LAD: Scenario A tau=.5 LP and KDE sandwich

metrics.coverage: all replications, invalid counts as uncovered
metrics.calibration: median SE / empirical SD; IQR version also provided
